claim_boundary: C018 records exact attacks and narrowed bridges. One formulation is rejected; all new descendants remain below proof status.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the circuit budget is measured by n while formula length may be n to a k-dependent power
attacks.method: Set L_k(n)=n^{k^2}. A hypothetical SAT circuit of size L^3 then has size n^{3k^2}, which exceeds n^k for every k, so H116's stated choose-k implication to SAT not in P/poly does not follow.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the witness-cover lower condition may be charged against the wrong external parameter
attacks.method: Rewrite the cover bound in terms of actual encoding length L; the construction survives but its use against H116 is weakened until H124 normalization.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: no concrete high-treewidth opposite-label local lift pair may exist
attacks.method: Construct the H121 toroidal Tseitin pair with charge patterns (2,0) and (1,1), exact local signature equality, and linear primal treewidth.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the local-twin idea may only work on easy low-treewidth cycles
attacks.method: Replace cycles by toroidal-grid Tseitin systems and retain exact bounded-radius local equality with opposite satisfiability.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the claimed SAT and UNSAT labels may be wrong
attacks.method: Construct an exact spanning-tree assignment for each even-charge component and reject every odd-charge component by XORing all vertex equations.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a bounded-radius root may detect whether both charges lie in one component
attacks.method: Use m=8R+13, separate the two SAT charges beyond every radius-R incidence view, and compare complete translation-normalized node signature multisets exactly.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the eight width-four clauses may encode the wrong parity equation
attacks.method: Enumerate exactly the eight forbidden local assignments for each charge and verify the generated SAT assignment against every clause.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the high-treewidth claim may rely on an incorrect primal graph or theorem normalization
attacks.method: Check exact primal-line-graph equality and separate the published toroidal and line-graph bounds into H122.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: incident graph edges may fail to co-occur in a clause
attacks.method: Every pair among the four variables at one vertex occurs together in each local width-four clause, creating the complete line-graph clique.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: nonincident graph edges may co-occur through the CNF encoding
attacks.method: Each clause belongs to one vertex equation and contains only the four incident edge variables.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the line-graph inequality may not yield m-1
attacks.method: Substitute tw(T_m)=2m-1 into tw(L(G)) >= (tw(G)+1)/2-1 to obtain m-1 exactly.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: using two components may lower the certified width
attacks.method: Treewidth of a disjoint union is the maximum component treewidth, so two copies retain the m-1 lower bound.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the identity map may remain an H106 counterexample as in H118
attacks.method: H121 primal treewidth is at least m-1=Omega(sqrt(N)), so identity does not satisfy the O(log N) output-width promise.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a low-treewidth transduction may explicitly encode component charge parity in a small output gadget
attacks.method: Bounded ancestry forbids direct inspection, but no theorem yet excludes distributed aggregation across the fixed passes.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: low treewidth alone may not force factorization through a common local quotient
attacks.method: Record quotient factorization as the sole missing theorem rather than infer it from local type equality.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: witness recovery may carry a global bit absent from the structural output
attacks.method: Require the factorization theorem to include every recovery annotation and provenance field.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the repaired anti-checker may still fail to imply a circuit lower bound
attacks.method: Measure exact SAT circuits and target circuits on the same L-bit input domain; choosing k above a hypothetical circuit exponent now closes the formal contradiction.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a union of listed witness evaluators may cover the entire positive list within L^k
attacks.method: Import H120 as an explicit necessary lower bound on distinct witness behavior.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a sound circuit may cover the list without representing witnesses separately
attacks.method: Leave incompressibility against all SAT-sound circuits as the first unproved theorem; witness diversity alone is not promoted.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: exact-length padding may change which strings are legal CNF encodings
attacks.method: Require a canonical length-L domain with explicit padding semantics and reject generators that compare circuits on a different input language.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the cycle construction cannot exclude identity compilation
attacks.method: H121 preserves the local parity mechanism on a family with linear primal-treewidth lower bound.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a fixed-pass compiler may exploit the easy treewidth of every known local twin
attacks.method: Present H121 as an explicit high-treewidth input family; the universal compiler refutation still depends on H123.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the gadget-transport route may not interact with the new local twins
attacks.method: Identify H121 as a structured source candidate, but no pseudoexpectation transport theorem is supplied.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: circuit anti-checker quantifiers may use an auxiliary generator parameter
attacks.method: Route the direct lower-bound target through H124's exact L-bit domain.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: range avoidance may again return only an uncertified false positive
attacks.method: H124 retains the SAT-sound promise but does not recover a range-avoidance decoder; the polarity wall remains.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: another transparent local construction may be mistaken for proof-hard endpoints
attacks.method: Keep H117's contextual upper bound active; no new H110 endpoint family is claimed in C018.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: C018 graph constructions might be misused as transparent EF-hard endpoint amplification
attacks.method: Record that H121 concerns SAT locality and treewidth, not equivalent-circuit rewrite distance.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the repaired H124 list may evade the cover only through parameter renaming
attacks.method: Restate the necessary cover inequality directly in L and require the generated witness set to exceed the L^k budget after evaluator cost.
